\[
g_{k+1} = \left(f \wedge \delta_N(g_k)\right) \vee \varepsilon_N(g_k)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f\): The image
- \(g_k\): The leveling after k steps
- \(N\): The 3 x 3 cross or square

f is the image and g_0 the marker. Each step dilates and erodes g with the 3 x 3 element N, caps the dilation at f and takes the larger of the two. The steps repeat until nothing changes, at most 2000 times. Where the marker lies below the image this is reconstruction by dilation, and where it lies above, reconstruction by erosion. The tests check both cases against scikit-image.
